alerts.title: Dhanteras Market Traffic Warning: Khandagiri Area
alerts.headline: Dhanteras Market Traffic Warning: Khandagiri Area
alerts.message: Surge in pre-festival retail shopping and delivery transit in Khandagiri Area (Heritage Foothills Buffer) is elevating localized NOx and PM2.5 levels. Heavy vehicular idle times expected.
alerts.explanation: Surge in pre-festival retail shopping and delivery transit in Khandagiri Area (Heritage Foothills Buffer) is elevating localized NOx and PM2.5 levels. Heavy vehicular idle times expected.
alerts.action_advised: Utilize non-motorized transport for local shopping; avoid idling engines in market corridors.
alerts.precaution: Utilize non-motorized transport for local shopping; avoid idling engines in market corridors.

alerts.title: Critical Diwali Night Pollution Alert: Khandagiri Area
alerts.headline: Critical Diwali Night Pollution Alert: Khandagiri Area
alerts.message: Projected peak AQI will surge to 549.2 (Severe category) on Diwali night (8 Nov). Calm nocturnal surface winds and shallow thermal boundary layer trap high-density fireworks emissions.
alerts.explanation: Projected peak AQI will surge to 549.2 (Severe category) on Diwali night (8 Nov). Calm nocturnal surface winds and shallow thermal boundary layer trap high-density fireworks emissions.
alerts.action_advised: Avoid all outdoor exertion between 8:00 PM and 2:00 AM; use HEPA air filtration indoors.
alerts.precaution: Avoid all outdoor exertion between 8:00 PM and 2:00 AM; use HEPA air filtration indoors.

alerts.headline: Post-Festival Smog Stagnation: Khandagiri Area
alerts.message: Residual festival particulates linger over Khandagiri Area under light wind conditions. Elevated PM2.5 levels continue into early morning hours.
alerts.explanation: Residual festival particulates linger over Khandagiri Area under light wind conditions. Elevated PM2.5 levels continue into early morning hours.
alerts.action_advised: Wear N95/N99 protective masks if commuting during morning hours; limit children's outdoor playtime.
alerts.precaution: Wear N95/N99 protective masks if commuting during morning hours; limit children's outdoor playtime.
